component.name: featherplay
component.summary: A light native player for YouTube Music

description.p: featherplay plays your YouTube Music library, playlists, search results and radio from one native program. It's written in Rust and drawn with Slint, so no web browser runs behind the window and nothing plays but the audio.
It keeps what people use most in a desktop player:

ul.li: Media keys and the system's media controls
SponsorBlock, which skips non-music segments in music videos

description.p: featherplay is an independent project. It isn't made, endorsed or supported by Google or YouTube. The Linux version is experimental.
